parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query range. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The filter parameter.

> See **Additional information about request parameters** for the supported filter parameters and their valid values.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the filter parameter.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the database instance.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description:
The node ID.

> For cluster instances only. You can specify a node ID to query its offline tasks. If this parameter is omitted, the offline tasks of the primary node are returned by default.

parameters.name: PageNo
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be a positive integer. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query range. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.
